audience: wholesale brands, showrooms and sales reps who take orders in Brandboom

useCases.title: Find open orders and their order PDFs
useCases.text: Search orders by keyword, order date, ship date or status. Then get a temporary PDF link for one order.

useCases.title: Check the invoices of a showroom
useCases.text: List the showrooms the account can access. Then search the invoices of one or more showrooms by date or keyword.

useCases.title: Look up products and their wholesale prices
useCases.text: List the price tiers and showrooms. Then search the products of one showroom and price tier by keyword, to read prices and SKUs.

useCases.title: Trace a shipment and its customer
useCases.text: Find shipments by shipment id or invoice id, filtered by status. Search the customer record of the buyer.
